name: Progress MS-15
about: Progress MS-15 (2020-050A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2020 Jul 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2020 Jul 23), held fixed
docked to A06581; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
